--background-screen.description: Main app background — lowest layer, always behind everything. Changing this shifts the overall mood of the product. ai-impact:high

--background-elevated.description: Elevated surface above screen — page content areas, sidebar backgrounds. Must always appear lighter than background/screen to communicate depth. ai-impact:high | ai-constraint:must be lighter than background/screen

--background-scrim.description: Semi-transparent scrim behind modals, drawers, bottom sheets. Alpha 0.25–0.6: too low loses focus, too high feels oppressive. ai-impact:medium

--surface-primary.description: Default surface for cards, panels, modal bodies, list containers. Most common surface in the system. ai-impact:high

--surface-secondary.description: Slightly off-white surface for nested containers, table rows, secondary panels. Creates subtle depth within a primary surface. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be visually distinct from surface/primary

--surface-tertiary.description: Deeply nested surfaces — third-level containers, inline code blocks. ai-impact:low

--surface-accent.description: Brand-tinted surface for selected states, highlighted rows, active nav backgrounds. Always a very light tint of the accent color — never saturated. ai-impact:medium

--surface-disabled.description: Background of disabled interactive surfaces. Communicates non-interactivity. Do not change. ai-locked:true

--surface-floating.description: Surface color of modals, bottom sheets, popovers — the element appearing above the background/overlay scrim. ai-impact:medium

--action-primary.description: Fill color for primary buttons and secondary outline stroke. In light mode near-black, in dark mode near-white — always the opposite of the button foreground. ai-impact:high

--action-primary-inverse.description: Fill for primary buttons inverse. In light mode near-white, in dark mode near-black — always the opposite of the button foreground. ai-impact:high

--action-secondary.description: Fill color for secondary, ghost, and outline buttons. Muted gray — communicates lower visual priority than action/primary. Also used for tertiary icon button fills. ai-impact:medium

--action-disabled.description: Fill color of disabled buttons and controls. Flat muted gray that signals non-interactivity.

--action-distructive.description: Fill color of destructive button surfaces (delete, remove, danger CTAs). Signals irreversibility and risk. Always red-family hue — never change the hue, only lightness allowed. Text on this background must use action/destructive-content. ai-locked:true | ai-constraint:always red-family hue, action/destructive-content must maintain 4.5:1 on this background

--action-accent.description: Fill for accent-colored interactive elements — links, active tabs, selected chips. Draws attention without the weight of action/primary. ai-impact:medium

--border-divider.description: Passive structural dividers — between list rows, table cells, section separators. Should be barely perceptible. If clearly visible at arm's length it is too strong. ai-impact:medium

--border-outline.description: Border of interactive form elements at rest — inputs, selects, textareas. Must clearly define the clickable area. Always stronger than border/divider. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be stronger than border/divider

--border-action.description: Border of outline-variant interactive elements — outline buttons, active input borders. Matches content/accent for consistency. ai-impact:medium

--content-primary.description: Main body text, headings, primary labels. Highest-contrast text color in the system. ai-impact:high | ai-constraint:7:1 contrast vs background/elevated for AAA compliance

--content-secondary.description: Supporting text — captions, metadata, helper text, timestamps. Clearly subordinate to content/primary. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:4.5:1 contrast vs surface/primary

--content-disabled.description: Placeholder text, ghost labels, very subtle hints. Lowest legibility tier — never use for critical information. ai-impact:low | ai-constraint:minimum 3:1 contrast

--content-primary-inverse.description: Primary text on dark surfaces — tooltips, dark cards, filled dark headers, primary buttons Inverse of content/primary. ai-impact:medium

--content-accent.description: Accent-colored text — inline links, active labels, highlighted values. Always the brand color applied to text. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:4.5:1 contrast vs surface/primary

--state-selected.description: Solid background for selected rows, active nav items, chosen list options. Indicates persistent selection rather than transient hover. ai-impact:medium

--state-focus-ring.description: Color of the keyboard focus indicator ring drawn around interactive elements. Must remain high-contrast and always visible — never suppress or hide. ai-impact:high | ai-locked:true

--state-hover-overlay.description: Universal hover overlay — semi-transparent layer on top of any interactive surface on mouse enter. Apply to buttons, list items, nav items. Flips to white-opacity in dark mode. ai-impact:medium

--state-hover-fill.description: Solid hover state for list rows and table rows where an overlay layer is not possible. Changes the background directly. ai-impact:medium

--state-pressed-overlay.description: Universal pressed/active overlay — stronger than state/hover. Applied on mouse down for tactile feedback. Alpha always greater than state/hover. ai-constraint:alpha must be > state/hover alpha

--state-pressed-fill.description: Solid pressed state for list rows where overlay is not possible. ai-impact:low

--sentiment-positive-background-strong.description: Saturated green surface — badge fill, status pill, prominent success indicator. Use when success needs high visibility against surrounding content. ai-impact:medium

--sentiment-positive-background-light.description: Tinted green surface — success alert background, inline success message container. Softer than background-strong, used for larger areas of positive feedback. ai-impact:medium

--sentiment-positive-foreground.description: Text and icon color for positive/success content. Use on background-light or white — never on background-strong. ai-impact:medium

--sentiment-positive-border.description: Border of success-state containers, inputs, and alert boxes. Pairs with background-light to frame positive feedback areas. ai-impact:low

--sentiment-warning-background-strong.description: Saturated amber surface — warning badge, caution pill. Use sparingly — warns without blocking user action. ai-impact:medium

--sentiment-warning-background-light.description: Tinted amber surface — warning alert background, caution message container. ai-impact:medium

--sentiment-warning-foreground.description:
Text and icon color for warning content.
Use on background-light or white — never on background-strong. ai-impact:medium

--sentiment-warning-border.description: Border of warning-state containers and alert boxes. ai-impact:low

--sentiment-negative-background-strong.description:
Saturated red surface — error badge, destructive status pill.
Use for explicit errors that require immediate attention. ai-impact:high

--sentiment-negative-background-light.description: Tinted red surface — error alert background, inline error message container. ai-impact:high

--sentiment-negative-foreground.description:
Text and icon color for error and destructive content.
Use on background-light or white — never on background-strong. ai-impact:high

--sentiment-negative-border.description:
Border of error-state inputs, containers, and alert boxes.
Signals invalid input or system failure — pairs with background-light. ai-impact:high

--sentiment-neutral-background-strong.description:
Neutral gray surface — default badge, unclassified status pill.
Use when status has no positive or negative connotation. ai-impact:low

--sentiment-neutral-background-light.description: Tinted neutral surface — informational alert background, generic tag container. ai-impact:low

--sentiment-neutral-foreground.description: Text and icon color for neutral informational content. ai-impact:low

--sentiment-neutral-border.description: Border of neutral-state containers and informational alert boxes. ai-impact:low

--elevation-soft.description:
Shadow color for lowest-elevation surfaces — subtle cards, resting panels.
Scales automatically between light and dark mode. ai-impact:low

--elevation-medium.description: Shadow color for mid-elevation surfaces — dropdowns, popovers, floating menus. ai-impact:medium

--elevation-strong.description: Shadow color for highest-elevation surfaces — modals, dialogs, command palettes. ai-impact:high

--expression-blue-background-strong.description:
Saturated blue surface — categorical label, tag, or data point requiring blue identity.
Use for data-driven color coding only, not for UI feedback meaning. ai-impact:low

--expression-blue-background-light.description: Tinted blue surface — larger categorical area, selected filter chip with blue identity. ai-impact:low

--expression-blue-foreground.description:
Text and icon on blue expression surfaces.
Always pair with background-light or background-strong from the same color. ai-impact:low

--expression-magenta-foreground.description:
Text and icon on magenta expression surfaces.
Always pair with background-light or background-strong from the same color. ai-impact:low

--corner-radius-none.description: No rounding — full-bleed elements, edge-to-edge banners, explicitly sharp components. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-xsmall.description: Barely rounded — for very subtle softening, almost-sharp aesthetic. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-small.description: Slight rounding — default for interactive controls (buttons, inputs) in the default personality. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-medium.description: Moderate rounding — default for cards and container surfaces. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-large.description: Prominent rounding — modals, popovers, overlays in default personality. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-xlarge.description: Strong rounding — interactive controls in rounded personality, container surfaces in bubbly. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-2xlarge.description: Very strong rounding — used in bubbly/expressive personality modes. | ai-group:roundness

--corner-radius-full.description: Fully circular/pill — chips, badges, avatar images, toggle switches. | ai-group:roundness

--stroke-stroke-hairline.description: Hairline border — structural dividers between list rows, table cells. Barely perceptible by design. | ai-group:weight

--stroke-stroke-thin.description: Standard border width — interactive form elements at rest: inputs, selects, card outlines. Universal default. | ai-group:weight

--stroke-stroke-medium.description: Medium border — slightly more prominent outlines, active states where extra visibility is needed. | ai-group:weight

--stroke-stroke-bold.description: Bold border — focus rings, active input borders, strong emphasis outlines. | ai-group:weight

--focus-focus-ring-width.description: Width of outer accessibility focus ring. Minimum 2px per WCAG 2.4.11. Never reduce below 2px. ai-locked:true | ai-constraint:minimum 2px WCAG requirement

--focus-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between focused element edge and focus ring. 2px creates clear visual separation. ai-locked:true

--inset-component-sm-x.description: Horizontal (left/right) padding of small interactive controls — compact buttons, small inputs in dense tables. Always larger than inset-component-sm-y for optical balance. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be > inset-component-sm-y

--inset-component-sm-y.description: Vertical (top/bottom) padding of small interactive controls. Ratio ~0.67 of inset-component-sm-x. Directly controls tap target height. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be < inset-component-sm-x

--inset-component-md-x.description: Horizontal padding of default/medium interactive controls — standard buttons and inputs. Most-used inset token. Increasing makes controls feel more generous and spacious. ai-impact:high | ai-constraint:must be > inset-component-md-y

--inset-component-md-y.description: Vertical padding of medium interactive controls. Directly determines tap target height. Ratio ~0.75 of inset-component-md-x. Never set equal to or greater than x. ai-impact:high | ai-constraint:must be < inset-component-md-x, ratio ~0.75

--inset-component-lg-x.description: Horizontal padding of large interactive controls — prominent CTAs, hero inputs, full-width actions. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be > inset-component-lg-y

--inset-component-lg-y.description: Vertical padding of large interactive controls. Ratio ~0.67 of inset-component-lg-x. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be < inset-component-lg-x

--inset-inline-sm-x.description: Horizontal padding of small inline elements — notification counts, dot badges, tiny status indicators. Always larger than inset-inline-sm-y. ai-impact:low

--inset-inline-sm-y.description: Vertical padding of small inline elements. Extremely tight — element sits flush with surrounding text line. ai-impact:low | ai-constraint:max 4px

--inset-inline-md-x.description: Horizontal padding of default chips, badges, filter tags. Standard pill padding. ai-impact:medium

--inset-inline-md-y.description: Vertical padding of default chips and badges. Never exceed 8px or badges break text line rhythm. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:max 8px

--inset-inline-lg-x.description: Horizontal padding of large filter chips and prominent category tags. ai-impact:low

--inset-inline-lg-y.description: Vertical padding of large chips and tags. ai-impact:low | ai-constraint:max 8px

--inset-container-sm.description: Compact container padding — dense lists, compact cards, tight info boxes. Equal on all sides — do not split x/y for containers. ai-impact:medium

--inset-container-md.description: Default card and panel padding. The most common container inset. Equal on all sides. ai-impact:high

--inset-container-lg.description: Comfortable padding for modals, bottom sheets, prominent panels. Equal on all sides. ai-impact:high

--inset-container-xl.description: Generous padding for hero cards, onboarding panels, full-page sections. Equal on all sides. ai-impact:medium

--inset-section-sm.description: Compact page section padding — mobile default and dense content pages. Controls macro breathing room of the full page layout. ai-impact:high

--inset-section-md.description: Standard page section padding — tablet and desktop default. Main lever for overall page airiness. Increasing alone makes the page feel editorial and open. ai-impact:high

--inset-section-lg.description: Spacious page section padding — hero sections, feature showcases, marketing pages. ai-impact:high

--gap-items-tight.description: Gap between closely grouped controls — button groups, radio clusters, segmented controls. Decreasing fuses elements together; increasing separates them into individual items. ai-impact:medium

--gap-items-default.description: Standard gap between sibling UI elements — form field rows, list items, menu options. The most-used gap token. Changing this has broad impact on perceived density across the entire UI. ai-impact:high

--gap-items-comfortable.description: Gap for grid items and navigation — card grid cells, nav rail items. Larger than default to give breathing room between cards. ai-impact:medium

--gap-stack-tight.description: Vertical gap between visually grouped text elements — heading + subheading, stat value + label. Controls whether these pairs read as a single unit. Never exceed 12px or the grouping breaks. ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:max 12px to preserve visual grouping

--gap-stack-default.description: Vertical gap between distinct but related content groups — between a form group and the next, between a heading and body text. The primary lever for vertical page rhythm. ai-impact:high

--gap-stack-loose.description: Vertical gap between loosely related content areas — rows of cards, sidebar sections. Creates visual separation without the weight of a full section break. ai-impact:medium

--gap-stack-section.description: Vertical gap between major page sections. Largest gap token in the system. Reducing makes the page feel like a continuous scroll; increasing creates distinct visual chapters. ai-impact:high

--gap-inline-tight.description: Horizontal gap between tightly packed inline elements — stacked avatars, inline chip groups, tag clouds. ai-impact:low

--gap-inline-default.description: Standard horizontal gap — toolbar actions, breadcrumb segments, nav items. Increasing makes navigation feel more open and touch-friendly. ai-impact:medium

--gap-inline-loose.description: Generous horizontal gap for top-level navigation and primary tab bars. Larger gaps signal these are the primary navigational choices. ai-impact:medium

--layout-grid-margin.description: Distance from the viewport edge to the content area. Controls the breathing room between UI and screen edge. Scales across breakpoints — larger on desktop, tighter on mobile. Increase for a more premium, spacious feel. ai-impact:high

--layout-grid-gutter.description: Space between columns in the layout grid. Controls visual separation between major content areas. Consistent across all content inside the grid. Increase to create more distinct column separation. ai-impact:medium

--layout-grid-columns.description: Number of columns in the layout grid. Defines the structural skeleton of every screen. Typically 12 on desktop, 8 on tablet, 4 on mobile. Changing this affects how components snap to the grid. ai-impact:high

--layout-workspace-width.description: The active working area width for app interfaces. Used in dashboard and tool layouts where content needs a defined working zone. ai-impact:medium

--layout-workspace-min-width.description: Minimum width before the workspace starts to break. Below this value horizontal scrolling begins. Do not set lower than the smallest supported viewport. ai-impact:low

--layout-workspace-max-width.description: Maximum width the workspace expands to on large screens. Prevents content from becoming too wide on ultra-wide displays. ai-impact:medium

--layout-canvas-min-width.description: Minimum supported content width. Below this the layout is not guaranteed to work correctly. ai-impact:low

--layout-canvas-max-width.description: Maximum width for reading and content-focused layouts. Used for article pages, forms, onboarding flows. Keeps line lengths comfortable for reading. Narrower than workspace — used when focus matters more than space. ai-impact:medium
